Period for which family pension is payable.The family pension is payable to the·widow up to the date of her remarriage.or death, whichever is earlier. In case where the widow dies or remarries, the children shall be paid family pension at the rates mentioned at (a) or (b) above, as applicable, and the same ·rate shall also apply to fatherless/motherless children.
